title: Case runners accepted symlinked verified runtime roots before artifact writes and native oracle execution
title_de: Case-Runner akzeptierten verlinkte verifizierte Runtime-Roots vor Artefakt-Schreibvorgängen und nativer Oracle-Ausführung
security_invariant: Before either case runner writes artifacts, compiles, reuses, executes, or launches a child harness below VERIFIED_RUN_ROOT, the selected root and every created runner-owned descendant must be private, current-user-owned, non-symlinked, and traversed without following links.
security_invariant_de: Bevor einer der Case-Runner unter VERIFIED_RUN_ROOT Artefakte schreibt, kompiliert, wiederverwendet, ausführt oder einen Child-Harness startet, müssen der ausgewählte Root und jeder erzeugte runner-eigene Descendant privat, dem aktuellen Benutzer zugeordnet, nicht verlinkt und ohne Link-Following traversiert sein.
protocol: local/shared-host CI and test-runner verified-artifact-root filesystem boundary
profile: Verified clean-history Parent replacement PR #213 at exact head 69a990503e8b430b2922111c455ae5183c8e1dd3; protected SHA-bound squash merge to master f335965fd5f7b9640fc39a1dd7873d46d7c989c5 with passing post-merge controls
summary: Before remediation, both lifecycle case runners applied Path(...).resolve() to the selected CLI/environment/default VERIFIED_RUN_ROOT before artifact-directory creation, allowing a lower-privileged shared-host actor to pre-create final or parent symlinks that redirected runner-owned writes and native oracle execution. The repair selects CLI > VERIFIED_RUN_ROOT > historical fallback through prepare_verified_runtime_artifact_root(), validates lexically and through descriptor-based no-follow owner/mode controls, fails closed with exit 77, and validates runner-created descendants. The verified clean-history replacement PR #213 passed exact-head controls and merged normally; its tree equals current master, where focused root-security tests and post-merge checks pass.
summary_de: Vor der Remediation wendeten beide Lifecycle-Case-Runner Path(...).resolve() auf den ausgewählten CLI-/Environment-/Default-VERIFIED_RUN_ROOT vor der Artefakt-Verzeichniserzeugung an; ein niedriger privilegierter Shared-Host-Akteur konnte dadurch finale oder Parent-Symlinks vorab erzeugen und runner-eigene Schreibvorgänge sowie die Native-Oracle-Ausführung umleiten. Die Reparatur wählt CLI > VERIFIED_RUN_ROOT > historischen Fallback über prepare_verified_runtime_artifact_root(), validiert lexikalisch und über Descriptor-basierte No-Follow-Owner-/Mode-Controls, schlägt mit Exit 77 fail-closed fehl und validiert runner-erzeugte Descendants. Der verifizierte Ersatz-PR #213 mit frischer Historie bestand Exact-Head-Controls und wurde normal gemergt; sein Tree entspricht aktuellem master, auf dem fokussierte Root-Security-Tests und Post-Merge-Checks bestehen.
observed_behavior: The pre-remediation root selection in both case runners followed a caller-controlled existing symlink with Path(...).resolve() before mkdir, artifact writes, compiler output, native-oracle reuse/execution, or a child harness. The predictable historical fallback is /var/tmp/ModSecurity-conector-verified. The source path is a local/shared-host filesystem integrity boundary; it is not a GitHub pull-request token, secret, network, or connector-request boundary.
observed_behavior_de: Die Pre-Remediation-Root-Selection in beiden Case-Runnern folgte mit Path(...).resolve() einem vom Caller kontrollierten bestehenden Symlink vor mkdir, Artefakt-Schreibvorgängen, Compiler-Output, Native-Oracle-Wiederverwendung/-Ausführung oder einem Child-Harness. Der vorhersagbare historische Fallback ist /var/tmp/ModSecurity-conector-verified. Der Source-Pfad ist eine lokale/shared-host-Dateisystem-Integritätsgrenze; er ist keine GitHub-Pull-Request-Token-, Secret-, Netzwerk- oder Connector-Request-Grenze.
expected_behavior: The two runners must preserve CLI > VERIFIED_RUN_ROOT > historical fallback precedence while rejecting unsafe, broad, foreign-owned, group/world-writable, final-symlinked, or parent-symlinked roots before any runner-owned write or child process. Explain-only behavior must not materialize a runtime root.
expected_behavior_de: Die beiden Runner müssen die Präzedenz CLI > VERIFIED_RUN_ROOT > historischer Fallback beibehalten und gleichzeitig unsichere, breite, fremdbesitzte, group/world-writable, final-verlinkte oder parent-verlinkte Roots vor jedem runner-eigenen Schreibvorgang oder Child-Prozess zurückweisen. Explain-only-Verhalten darf keinen Runtime-Root materialisieren.
impact: A successful local/shared-host pre-seed could redirect evidence artifacts and, on the native path, cause a trusted developer or runner to reuse or execute a substituted fixed-name oracle. The impact is confined to a local actor sharing the host and a timing/filesystem precondition; there is no evidence of remote reachability, public endpoint exposure, GitHub external-PR/token escalation, secret access, connector request-processing impact, or normal hosted-CI attacker path. Severity is therefore low/P3.
impact_de: Ein erfolgreicher lokaler/shared-host-Preseed konnte Evidence-Artefakte umleiten und auf dem nativen Pfad einen vertrauenswürdigen Developer oder Runner dazu bringen, ein ersetztes Oracle mit festem Namen wiederzuverwenden oder auszuführen. Der Impact ist auf einen lokalen Akteur mit gemeinsamem Host und einer Timing-/Dateisystem-Voraussetzung begrenzt; es gibt keine Evidence für Remote-Reachability, Public-Endpoint-Exposition, GitHub-External-PR-/Token-Eskalation, Secret-Zugriff, Connector-Request-Processing-Impact oder einen normalen Hosted-CI-Angreiferpfad. Der Schweregrad ist daher low/P3.
preconditions: A lower-privileged local actor shares a host or self-hosted runner with the invoking identity and can create a path below the sticky /var/tmp parent before the runner's private child is created.
The runner selects the historical fallback or a caller-supplied VERIFIED_RUN_ROOT that has an existing final or parent symlink.
The invoking process reaches runner-owned artifact creation; native impact additionally requires compiler/oracle prerequisites and the native execution path.
reproduction: On the pre-remediation source, trace the selected --verified-run-root or VERIFIED_RUN_ROOT through Path(...).resolve() before runner-created directories and native-oracle/harness actions.
Use the focused direct runner controls with a final-root symlink and a parent-component symlink; the repaired candidate returns 77 before target mutation or output creation for both runners.
Do not run a live cross-user race. The retained source-to-sink trace and deterministic symlink controls establish the bounded local/shared-host condition without unsafe concurrent manipulation.

root_cause: The case runners treated resolution of an absolute-looking pathname as sufficient authority. Path.resolve() follows an attacker-planted link before the existing no-follow, ownership, and mode controls can inspect it. The resulting redirected tree then becomes the parent of predictable artifact and native-oracle paths. The remediation centralizes selection into the existing descriptor-based validated-root primitive and validates runner-created descendants before their first use.
root_cause_de: Die Case-Runner behandelten die Auflösung eines absolut aussehenden Pfadnamens als ausreichende Autorität. Path.resolve() folgt einem vom Angreifer angelegten Link, bevor die bestehenden No-Follow-, Ownership- und Mode-Controls ihn prüfen können. Der dadurch umgeleitete Baum wird dann Parent von vorhersagbaren Artefakt- und Native-Oracle-Pfaden. Die Remediation zentralisiert die Selection in die bestehende Descriptor-basierte Validated-Root-Primitive und validiert runner-erzeugte Descendants vor ihrer ersten Verwendung.
proposed_remediation: Keep the shared prepare_verified_runtime_artifact_root() selection helper as the only verified-root enforcement point. Preserve CLI > VERIFIED_RUN_ROOT > fallback precedence, lexically absolutize without link resolution, delegate to the existing no-follow private-root validator, return 77 before runner-owned writes or children on ValueError, and create runner-owned case/log/oracle directories with ensure_safe_runtime_directory(). Retain direct final-/parent-symlink negative controls and legitimate precedence/private-mode/explain controls. Do not weaken workflow permissions, Sonar rules, Quality Gates, test controls, or other separate root contracts.
proposed_remediation_de: Den gemeinsamen Selection-Helper prepare_verified_runtime_artifact_root() als einzigen Verified-Root-Enforcement-Point beibehalten. Die Präzedenz CLI > VERIFIED_RUN_ROOT > Fallback bewahren, ohne Link-Resolution lexikalisch absolutisieren, an den bestehenden No-Follow-Private-Root-Validator delegieren, bei ValueError vor runner-eigenen Schreibvorgängen oder Children Exit 77 liefern und runner-eigene Case-/Log-/Oracle-Verzeichnisse mit ensure_safe_runtime_directory() erzeugen. Direkte finale-/Parent-Symlink-Negative-Controls sowie legitime Präzedenz-/Private-Mode-/Explain-Controls beibehalten. Workflow-Berechtigungen, Sonar-Regeln, Quality Gates, Test-Controls oder andere separate Root-Verträge nicht abschwächen.
acceptance_criteria: Both runners preserve CLI > VERIFIED_RUN_ROOT > historical fallback precedence and return 77 before writes or child-process launch when the selected root is unsafe.
Final-root and parent-component symlink variants cannot mutate the symlink target or native summary output through either runner interface.
A legitimate private root is created with safe modes; relative input is lexically normalized and --explain does not materialize a verified runtime root.
Focused source/test/security-diff controls pass on the committed candidate without a Framework/MRTS action, control weakening, suppression, or Quality-Gate change.
After push, the exact PR head has fresh hosted GitHub/Sonar evidence before any verified or closed disposition.
validation_plan: Retain the local hardening receipt and sealed security-diff scan with their SHA-256 values.
Rerun py_compile, focused runtime artifact/path/report tests, terminal-status compatibility, and git diff --check after final documentation/commit changes.
Keep Framework-dependent tests blocked_missing_local_checkout rather than initializing or changing Framework/MRTS to obtain a passing result.
After push, compare local, remote, and PR SHA; then read exact-head required GitHub checks and SonarQube Cloud results.
legitimate_control_tests: Explicit CLI root overrides VERIFIED_RUN_ROOT, which overrides the fallback, and the resulting root is private and non-symlinked.
run-verified-case.py --explain returns without materializing the requested verified runtime root.
The existing generated-report evidence suite preserves exact Markdown and full-matrix command semantics after literal extraction.
residual_risk: The repair covers only verified-run-root selection and runner-created descendants. It does not claim safety for separate caller-owned --build-root, --tmp-root, native --output-dir, connector/framework roots, or a same-UID actor that can mutate an already-private root. Those boundaries remain explicitly outside this closed finding; the targeted regression, legitimate controls, fresh range Secret Scanning, hosted verification, protected merge, and post-merge checks passed.
residual_risk_de: Die Reparatur deckt nur die Verified-Run-Root-Selection und runner-erzeugte Descendants ab. Sie beansprucht keine Sicherheit für separate caller-eigene --build-root, --tmp-root, native --output-dir, Connector-/Framework-Roots oder einen Same-UID-Akteur, der einen bereits privaten Root verändern kann. Diese Grenzen bleiben ausdrücklich außerhalb dieses geschlossenen Findings; der zielgerichtete Regressionstest, Legitimate-Controls, frisches Range-Secret-Scanning, Hosted-Validierung, geschützter Merge und Post-Merge-Checks bestanden.
